column1: # The gate-mutant suite (#fyvmsy8, @system_adamic's ruling Oct 9 06:21Z, built by @system_adamic_tests on #f3p1c0z): planted
# candidates whose verdict a correct gate already knows. Every stage canary and every half-hourly main canary gates each one
# with the canary's own tools (cloud/fast-gate-watch.sh), and staged box tools promote only when every mutant reads as
# declared here. Each is a single commit on main, pinned by sha so a moved branch never changes the suite; never
# merge one. A mutant that stops merging cleanly onto main reads red at merge, which is no expected verdict: rebase it.
# name<TAB>sha<TAB>step<TAB>pattern: the red must be at that step, and the pattern (an extended regex, may be empty) must
# match the first failure's block of the gate's log. An empty file is no suite; a missing one holds every promotion.
# The control, a plain wrong answer in a package nothing imports, so the fast gate selects it alone and names it (@system_adamic_tests,
# Oct 9 14:16Z; it replaces plain-wrong-answer, whose buildcache change selected 96 units and stopped first on another package).
# Any statecopy test is a correct first failure: the flipped argument check breaks every test that runs the tool, and
# main added TestPublishedCopyModeIsPrivate (publication_unix_test.go), which now fails first (Oct 9 16:29Z misread).
plain-wrong-answer-leaf
binary-dies-partway
deferred-red-reaches-census

# Hole 5, a canary that runs nothing: ten empty commits on main ce1c5a2f, gated against its tip~10 as a canary is; it
# must read as thin (under the canary's 500 passed tests), which a canary reads void and never promotes on. Empty, not
# docs-only: gitignore's tests read every path and markdowninline's every .md, so the docs-only cut (8820bb5c) selected
# both, passed 2170 tests and read as a wrong green (Oct 9 15:43Z).
